requiredFindings.title: A SEAL that stops before the evidence COMMIT never releases level 4
requiredFindings.failureScenario: r1 RF-1's order is now in item 8 and matches X3b r5 item 5 step 7, X4 r4 item 3, and the build plan on the path that reaches the evidence COMMIT: journal transaction, ledger transaction, level 4, SEAL and the COMMITTED witness, staging, X4's repeated checkpoint and AdmissionPermit, ledger COMMIT, then release. Level 3 is never acquired under level 4. The release is stated only as step 8, once COMMIT returns Committed or CommitUndetermined. The rejected sentence and the forbidden-substitutes line forbid releasing level 4 before the evidence commit, with no stop. An uncertain journal barrier (X3b item 5: no evidence commit proceeds), a staging abort (item 6 aborts without commit and does not release level 4), and a failed post-SEAL checkpoint or AdmissionPermit refusal (X4 r4 item 3, X3b item 10 F19, build plan F19 and F38) never call that COMMIT. Level 4 is the in-process JournalAppendLock. Holding it until a COMMIT that must not be called leaves the fresh level-3 then level-4 REV unable to run. F19 requires the release before the evidence commit. Item 7's outcomes are success and CommitUndetermined; the amendment's name Committed is not an item 7 outcome. Required: on the path that calls the evidence COMMIT, level 4 stays held until COMMIT returns success or CommitUndetermined, then is released. If the SEAL path stops before the evidence COMMIT (uncertain journal barrier, staging abort, or checkpoint or AdmissionPermit refusal), level 4 is released at that stop, before any fresh level-3 then level-4 REV. Level 3 is never acquired or reacquired under level 4. The forbidden sentence must allow that stop's release.

scope: Law X3c r2 paired with X3b r5. r1 RF-1 is closed on the path that reaches COMMIT. RF-1: a SEAL stop before the evidence COMMIT has no level-4 release, and the forbidden list forbids the F19 release. No product cargo.
